newsitem.title: UK: Labour has unchanged 21 pct lead in new UK poll.
newsitem.headline: Labour has unchanged 21 pct lead in new UK poll.

text.p: The British opposition Labour party's opinion poll lead ahead of a May 1 election has stayed steady at 21 points and the ruling Conservatives show little signs of recovery, a new poll said on Tuesday. The MORI poll for the Evening Standard newspaper put support for Labour at 50 percent, the same figure recorded by a similar poll in mid-March, while backing for Prime Minister John Major's Conservatives was also unchanged at 29 percent.
The minority Liberal Democrats rose one point to 15 percent.

The latest survey suggested Labour had recovered from a dip in support. Two polls on Sunday said the party's lead over the Conservatives had dipped to 16 points, down as much as seven points from the week before.
MORI interviewed 1,778 adults across Britain between April 11 and 14 for the latest Standard poll.
